text: Visitors have noted issues with parking availability, especially due to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces, which has caused frustration. Several reviews mentioned difficulties with the timed-entry ticket system, including the requirement to purchase tickets online in advance and the inability to buy tickets on-site. Crowding inside the library has been a common concern, with some visitors feeling rushed and unable to fully engage with the exhibits. There is also criticism of the heavy use of AI in interactive displays, which some found detracted from the experience. Additionally, some visitors reported problems with payment methods and limited gift shop options related to the library.
